states.name: final-us-ahead
states.description: Turn 10, the last action round (US to act, holding Duck and Cover; USSR holds Fidel). The US has a real position in Central America, South America and Africa, the USSR in Asia and the Middle East; the China Card is the USSR's. Passing ends the game: every region is scored, the China Card pays 1 VP, and the VP leader wins.

states.name: final-draw
states.description: Turn 10, the last action round, on an empty board with the USSR one VP ahead (-1) and the China Card the US's: its point levels the score, so the game is a draw.

states.name: final-china-card-decides
states.description: Turn 10, the last action round, on an empty board, level at 0 VP with the China Card the USSR's (face down): its one point wins the game for the USSR.

states.name: final-europe-control
states.description: Turn 10, the last action round, with the USSR controlling every Europe battleground (and the UK) while the US leads 12 VP: Europe's Control is still an outright win, so the USSR wins despite the VP.

states.name: final-vp-cap
states.description: Turn 10, the last action round, with the US already on 19 VP and a Central America position worth more: scoring it pushes the track to the +20 cap, an immediate US win (VictoryReason::Vp) before the other regions and the China Card are scored.
